title: Recognizing Atari and Assessing Sente: Controlled Evaluation Tasks for Language-Based Go Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22953v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Domain terminology provides concise descriptions of game states and strategic relationships, but whether game-playing language models can accurately recognize these concepts and relate them to move evaluation remains unclear. We construct a controlled evaluation set centered on atari and its relationship to sente in Go, examining terminology recognition under local board changes and move evaluation under different strategic conditions. We conduct our tests on LoGos, a Go language model, after fine-tuning it with terminology and commentary supervision. The model struggles to recognize changes in the atari relationship and assess its strategic implications. Its terminology predictions are associated with move preferences even when those preferences contradict the reference evaluation. translated_title: 识别叫吃与评估先手：面向基于语言的围棋智能体的受控评估任务
translated_abstract: 领域术语为游戏状态和战略关系提供了简洁的描述，但下棋语言模型能否准确识别这些概念并将其与着法评估相关联，目前仍不清楚。我们构建了一个以围棋中“叫吃”及其与“先手”的关系为核心的受控评估集，考察局部棋盘变化下的术语识别能力以及不同战略条件下的着法评估能力。我们在LoGos——一个围棋语言模型上进行了测试，该模型经过了术语和棋评监督的微调。结果显示，该模型难以识别叫吃关系的变化并评估其战略含义。即使其着法偏好与参考评估相矛盾，其术语预测仍与着法偏好相关联。我们的受控测试提供了一个框架，用于检验基于语言的围棋智能体是否能够将领域术语与精确的棋盘关系及战略评估联系起来。
tldr: 该论文构建了以围棋“叫吃”及其与“先手”关系为核心的受控评估集，发现经术语和棋评微调的围棋语言模型LoGos难以识别叫吃关系变化并评估其战略含义，为检验语言型围棋智能体能否将领域术语与精确棋盘关系关联起来提供了评估框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a controlled evaluation benchmark centered on atari and its relationship to sente in Go, revealing that the fine-tuned Go language model LoGos struggles to recognize changes in atari relationships and assess their strategic implications, thereby providing a framework for testing whether language-based Go agents connect domain terminology with precise board relationships.
